name: questions.cloud_infrastructure.baseline
description: Baseline questions for cloud footprint, topology, and Infrastructure-as-Code maturity.

questions.text: Which cloud provider(s) host production workloads?
questions.rationale: Cloud choice prunes service catalog, compliance options, and pricing model assumptions.

questions.text: Is the platform single-region, multi-region active/passive, or multi-region active/active?
questions.rationale: Topology determines RTO/RPO ceiling and drives significant cost/complexity trade-offs.

questions.text: What is the containerisation / compute strategy?
questions.rationale: Compute model drives operator skill requirements and the deployment pipeline's shape.

questions.text: Which Infrastructure-as-Code tool is in use?
questions.rationale: IaC tool choice and coverage gap tell us how reproducible the environment actually is.

questions.text: How many environments exist (dev, staging, prod, DR, preview) and are they parity-true to prod?
questions.rationale: Parity gaps are where late-stage surprises come from — common root cause for prod-only bugs.
